parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against human Beta-secretase 1 (CHEMBL4822). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL4822 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno. Sort results by compound ChEMBL identifier.
